notes.title: Patch notes 3!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789329/decbecda1356d7339a93f568985fcc1d5d8d7886.png[/img]

Hey team!

I've been hard at work ironing out the kinks, trying to make a pleasant game for you all!

This patch is really about smoothing out the gameplay experience.
[list]
[*]Firstly, the extremely janky enemies have been overhauled to make them actually interesting to engage with! No more snapping to directions, more varied movesets, and a bit more blow for blow. They should feel more like a natural extension of the world.

[*]Secondly, the spell system has been overhauled! Casting spells in the past was an awful affair, and pretty well useless. If youre in combat, you really dont want to have to put yourself in harms way to do something thats not even that useful. Instead, once spells are unlocked, praying brings up a spell select wheel, and you can cast spells on the fly by tapping! This gives you freedom to cast while running, flying, jumping, weaving in and out, and opens up the space for more exploration and platforming oriented spells too.

[*]Thirdly, the movement has been smoothed out significantly. In previous versions, there was a lot of hard deceleration, weird spurts of speed, and inconsistent momentum when changing around between Roll's various actions. These should all be a bit more in line, and flow together nicely!

[*]Finally there have been some more additions to the demo map to make it more appealing to run around. A few extra quests to do, a few more items to collect, easier ways to get back to old areas, a few more indirect routes to make exploration enjoyable.
[/list]
This will probably be the last big feature update for the demo, with the main focus being shifted onto the final games levels now. Bug fixes and some quality of life stuff may still be come as needed though.

As always, please let me know your thoughts!

notes.title: Patch Notes 2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789329/6d085981fd3fc34e98bc9c2fac8d15638412b22c.gif[/img]

I bet you thought I wouldn't do it huh

Well I did

Here are the big changes, piped directly to your personal computer:

[list]
[*] The sprint is overhauled!! Tbh my number one complaint from people is the sprint feeling icy and uncontrollable, so now its got a bit more affordance to the whole thing. I still wanted to keep it unruly as a tradeoff for the speed, but now it should at least feel like you are the one in control
[*] A seperate glide button! Another big complaint was trying to control the camera while gliding, especially on controller. This should add a bit of ease to that situation, and also potentially unlock new tech since activating a glide doesn't consume any crystals. 
[*] New NPC models! The previous ones were placeholder, sorry if you got attached. These guys are super cool though and in line with the theme of the world (every creature will have rings or halos I s2g)
[*] Added a Guard!! This is to give a bit more counterplay to missiles in air etc, and also works as a momentum stopper, for immediate brakes when dashing or plunging through the air (hopefully it can get you out of some sticky combat and platforming situations)
[*] Added a camera reset button, middle mouse on keyboard and right stick on controller. Always handy to have
[/list]


There are some "massive" (by my standards) changes to some controls and movement, so feedback is super appreciated! It was optimized for controller, but I have played it on keyboard and mouse and I think it feels ok but let me know (keyboard remapping is still in the works for the future but 1. it takes time cause its hard and 2. I still want the default controls to feel good since most players will use them)

So please please if you have any thoughts send em my way and I can almost guarantee they will be included in the game

notes.title: Patch Notes 1
notes.notes:
Hello!

After reading through all of you comments and feedbacks, I've made some fixes to the game! 

There are some things I'm still working on, but I wanted to deliver a version that works in the meantime while I work on some bigger problems, like issues with stuttering, or more design based problems like gliding controls (I think I'll make a separate glide button? But unsure)

But for the stuff that's fixed:
[list]
[*] New Game works properly now! You can reset save files
[*] Orbs properly save now! You don't have to collect them all at once
[*] I added a tenth orb, I'm so sorry I had awful cursed game design in there accidentally, there were only 9 orbs !! It was impossible to get them all. Kinda torturous from me ngl sorry
[*] Camera Sensitivity settings! It's now possible to adjust the camera speed, in case you think my predetermined speeds aren't pristine
[*] Loading Screen animation! Cuter this time, still needs some cleaning though
[*] Some minor UI issues like health not updating on game reload properly etc
[/list]

Thanks so much for sticking by this game and keep an eye out for more news! Big things coming

And please feel free to contact me at any time, I always comb through the community hub and I love feedback I want to make this game as good as possible for the people playing.

Still hard at work fixing some of the other known problems, so don't worry!
